Version 1.0.3 of phy-investor-wechat-update

- No file changes detected in this release.
- No updates to features, logic, or content.

- Added "Author" section with creator and contact details.
- No changes to core features or functionality.
- Documentation now includes attribution and relevant external links.

- 新增 homepage 字段，指向 https://canlah.ai
- 其余内容未变

- Initial release of investor-wechat-update skill.
- Generates professional WeChat updates for early-stage founders (angel/seed) to send to investors.
- Supports three scenarios: regular progress updates, good news sharing, and seeking help with challenges.
- Provides structured, concise, copy-paste-ready WeChat message templates.
- Incorporates best practices and templates from YC, Visible.vc, Uncork Capital, and leading Chinese VC communities.
- Triggers on keywords like “投资人更新”, “月度更新”, “好消息分享”, and “向投资人求助”.
